main_text.p: emonstrat, nisi probandum suscepis-m Le Vasseur nunquam Sylvio con-adicere, quin Hippocrati pariter iisque Veteribus contradixerit.

Porrò effervescentia illa promovet ἐδόσιν [?] distributionem, adde perficit imùm atque absolvit effervescendo oncoctionem cibi in stomacho fer-entati, deinde distribuit: chyli au-, addo & spirituum, distributionem fariam juvat, primùm diffipatione, enim vi illius intestini motûs sive effervescentiæ, spiritus quidam minus gati diffipantur, & per Lacteas ve-s aliaque spiracula corpori reli-uo, præcipuè cordi communicantur. einde etiam crassioribus cibi fer-entati & effervescentiam passi par-ous veluti coagulatis & à chylo se-egatis, ut caseus à Lacte, chylus on modò paratior est, ut inde disce-t, sed & eâdem illâ effervescentiâ omovetur, ipse & velut stimulis citantur intestina ad motum peri-stal-

page.notes: The left edge of the scan cuts off the start of most lines, so the opening letters of the lines are missing. The Greek word on the fourth line of the second paragraph is only partly visible and is uncertain. The final line of the page is a hyphenated fragment "stal-" continued on the next page.
